description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Country' model within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation' namespace. It provides methods to manage country entities in an OpenCart system, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving country data, as well as counting total countries and filtering by various criteria.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A model class for managing country data within the OpenCart admin localisation module, extending the core engine Model class.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Inserts a new country record into the database with provided data and clears the country cache.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Updates an existing country record identified by its ID with new data, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Deletes the country record with the specified ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data of a specific country by its ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Retrieves country data based on the ISO 2-letter code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Retrieves country data based on the ISO 3-letter code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCountries
methods.description: Returns the total number of countries matching specified filters.

methods.name: getTotalCountriesByAddressFormatId
methods.description: Counts countries associated with a specific address format ID.
